title: Authenticated learner intake and subskill evidence
goal: Keep authorized learner information, trustworthy recent performance and cumulative learning history for preparation.
rationale: Separate assessment, preferences and observations so preparation does not invent learner facts.
scope: Initial concise draft; specification only, no implementation or acceptance claimed. Adult A2–B2 English pilot. Sources: Product Decisions PD-06–09/28; Architecture sections 6–7/9. Detailed schemas and calculation cases will be refined before implementation. PD-39/40 add separately dated/source-qualified activity facts and derived cumulative context; recent metric rules and privacy remain unchanged.

requirement.title: Authenticated learner intake and subskill evidence
requirement.statement: Store learner assessment, preferences and dated lesson/homework observations under tutor ownership. Keep accuracy, required use and appropriate avoidance distinct, retain provenance/uncertainty, and derive qualified trends without inventing missing evidence. Store assignment, actual encounter, attempt and checked outcome as distinct dated/source-qualified facts with confirmation and task/assistance context, not a mandatory progression. Planned content remains in drafts; generation/approval/copying/feedback creates no activity evidence. Derive cumulative context across retained months separately from recent PD-08/09 rates; correct/deduplicate facts, freeze references when used and preserve unknown/unavailable-source qualifications.

scenarios.given: An authorized tutor has adult confirmation, a dated provisional assessment and lesson notes.
scenarios.then: Assessment, preferences and observations remain distinguishable with their sources and uncertainty; a transcript is not required.
scenarios.verification: Future intake/save/read observation using the real application and persisted records.

scenarios.given: A tutor requests another tutor's learner records.
scenarios.when: The application reads or changes learner information.
scenarios.then: Access is refused without disclosing or changing those records.

scenarios.given: A subskill has no observed opportunities or has uncertain extracted evidence.
scenarios.then: Unknown values stay unknown and uncertain extraction is not treated as confirmed performance.
scenarios.verification: Future performance-summary cases with zero and unconfirmed observations.

scenarios.given: Confirmed relevant activity facts are older than 90 days and some raw sources have expired under policy.
scenarios.when: Preparation context and recent performance views are loaded.
scenarios.then: Retained structured history can inform a qualified revisit with dates/references and unavailable-source markers; old facts do not enter recent denominators or establish forgetting/mastery, and no expired quotation is reconstructed.
scenarios.verification: Future persisted selection/controlled-clock cases comparing recent eligible IDs/counts with cumulative context and expiry behavior.

scenarios.given: A draft is approved/copied, one activity is tutor-confirmed assigned, and another reading/listening encounter is confirmed without an answer attempt.
scenarios.when: The tutor supplies evidence through intake and preparation is summarized.
scenarios.then: Draft/copying creates no assignment/exposure; assignment alone proves no encounter. Preserve the independently confirmed encounter without inventing an attempt, opportunity count or mastery. Missing dates/amounts and unconfirmed reports stay qualified.
scenarios.verification: Future intake/review/export row comparisons with synthetic planned, assigned-only and encounter-only records; inspect dates, confirmation and unknown rates.

scenarios.given: The same learner response/activity is imported twice and one source-qualified fact is corrected.
scenarios.when: The tutor confirms the correction and a new request loads history.
scenarios.then: Link/supersede and deduplicate the facts/observations rather than increasing exposure or performance counts twice; existing frozen requests retain their selected revisions.
scenarios.verification: Future real intake/persistence/snapshot correction and duplicate-import checks.

tasks.description: Persist tutor-owned profiles and source-qualified lesson/homework observations.
Expose separate subskill measures and qualified trends for preparation.
Persist independent activity facts and derive/freeze qualified cumulative context without altering recent metric selection or creating evidence from artifacts.
